_comment: Edit this file when you upload a new drug-card class. Do NOT edit index.html. Price = cardCount x kesPerCard (unless you set price explicitly, e.g. bundles). Put the zip at fileUrl and optional sample JPG at sample.

items.name: Beta-Blockers
items.description: 6 cards — Class overview, Metoprolol, Carvedilol, Bisoprolol, Atenolol, Propranolol.

items.name: ACE Inhibitors & ARBs
items.description: 12 cards — class overviews plus Lisinopril, Enalapril, Captopril, Ramipril, Benazepril, Losartan, Valsartan, Irbesartan, Candesartan, Olmesartan.

items.name: Calcium Channel Blockers
items.description: 6 cards — class overview plus Amlodipine, Nifedipine, Felodipine, Diltiazem, Verapamil.

items.name: Diuretics
items.description: 10 cards — Furosemide, Bumetanide, Torsemide, Hydrochlorothiazide, Chlorthalidone, Spironolactone, Amiloride, Triamterene, Mannitol, Acetazolamide.

items.name: Quinolones, Aminoglycosides & Tetracyclines
items.description: Three classes frequently compared on exams.

items.name: NSAIDs
items.description: 9 cards — Aspirin, Ibuprofen, Naproxen, Diclofenac, Ketorolac, Indomethacin, Mefenamic acid, Meloxicam, Celecoxib.

items.name: Opioids
items.description: 10 cards — Codeine, Fentanyl, Pethidine, Tramadol, Oxycodone, Hydromorphone, Methadone, Buprenorphine, Nalbuphine, Naloxone.

items.name: Antidiabetics
items.description: 8 cards — Metformin, Glipizide, Sitagliptin, Empagliflozin, Semaglutide, Insulin Lispro, Insulin NPH, Insulin Glargine.

items.name: Gastrointestinal
items.description: PPIs, H2 blockers, antiemetics, and more.

items.name: Anticoagulants & Antiplatelets
items.description: 12 cards — anticoagulants and antiplatelets including Heparin, Enoxaparin, Warfarin, Rivaroxaban, Apixaban, Clopidogrel, Ticagrelor, Prasugrel, Dipyridamole, Cilostazol.

items.name: Complete Bundle (All Classes)
items.description: Every class above, once complete — cheaper than buying each separately.
